messages:
maria: noticed a weird spike in unique series from ap-sg around 02:13 UTC, remote_write p95 jumped to ~12s and a bunch of 504s. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/scrape-pipeline -> ap-sg cluster
aj: on it, pulling prometheus logs and proxy queues now
sre-bot: alert triggered: REMOTE_WRITE_QUEUE_UTIL > 0.9 (rw-proxy-ap-sg) :rotating_light:
luca: quick glance at exporter logs — gpu-prober v2.6 just rolled to ap-sg yesterday. logs show metric lines with a label that looks like a timestamp suffix: e.g.
```
gpu_prober_probe_samples_total{job="gpu-prober",instance="gpu-01.ap-sg",probe_waveform="wave-1658421987123"} 42
```
luca: that probe_waveform label value is high-cardinality (epoch-ish suffix). looks like the prober started encoding the sample timestamp into the label rather than as a metric timestamp
kevin: if metric label changes every scrape we'll explode series cardinality. could explain remote_write queue and p95s
maria: also seeing the scrape interval jitter in prometheus: target_interval_length_seconds_count shows lots of sub-second variance for these exporters. combined with unique labels = many series across resamples
aj: extracted a promql snapshot: 
```
count_values("probe_waveform", gpu_prober_probe_samples_total{job="gpu-prober",job=~"gpu-prober.*ap-sg"})
```
-> shows thousands of distinct values in 10m window
kevin: quick mitigation: add metric_relabel_configs to drop probe_waveform for gpu-prober job. sample snippet: 
```
- job_name: gpu-prober
  static_configs: [...]
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: "probe_waveform"
```
maria: agreed. prefer metric_relabel on scrape side to avoid touching RW proxies mid-incident. can we roll that to all ap-sg prometheus replicas?
oncall-kyra: I can push a FiT (fast infra tweak) to the prom-staging and then to prom-ap-sg replicas; will schedule a 5m window now
luca: long term we should patch gpu-prober to stop emitting dynamic waveform labels (file a bug/PR). also add unit test to prevent labels with epoch-like suffixes
aj: test plan: push metric_relabel to staging, confirm decrease in distinct series via: `topk(10, count by(job) (count_values("probe_waveform", gpu_prober_probe_samples_total)))` then promote
kevin: also recommend lowering alert sensitivity for REMOTE_WRITE_QUEUE_UTIL to avoid noise while we mitigate; but keep paging threshold the same
maria: one more ask: add a temporary recording rule to track delta in series_count for job=gpu-prober so we can graph regression after fix
oncall-kyra: patch pushed to staging -> prom-staging accepted -> will promote in 3m. monitoring now
sre-bot: incident note created: INC-20253 — prober-waveform-label-cardinality. assigned to eng-prober and eng-sre
aj: staging confirms distinct probe_waveform values collapsed to 1 after metric_relabel. queues draining, p95 trending down
maria: rolling to prod ap-sg now
luca: opened GH issue: redwood/gpu-prober#412 — ensure labels are stable and timestamps are proper metric timestamps
kevin: follow-ups: (1) revert prober canary in ap-sg until fix, (2) add metric_relabel as safety net for 72h, (3) shortlist exporters to audit for similar patterns
maria: thanks team. keeping incident open until rw queues normal for 1h
oncall-kyra: noted, will update incident at +30m
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: closing thread here when everything stable, good catch on prober waveforms everyone
